normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every row also pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of all 236 post-Batch-51 natural-language survivors with an immediate accepted neighbor and a second accepted row on the same side, plus exact whole-family expansion for connected sentence fragments and repeated placeholder tokens. Accept only separable disposable text proven by full-payload and aligned import-preimage evidence. Retain poetry, dialogue, narrative, functional copy, titles, identities, attribution, structural lettering, source-significant content, and ambiguity. Earlier retain-by-omission decisions may be superseded only when stronger whole-family evidence is enumerated.
